messages:
elaine_mktg: Noticed a cluster of unassigned webinar leads this morning. looks like enrichment timeouts + RR churn. want a small-scope cooldown we can ship today to reduce duplicates and mean time to assign.

omar_salesops: same page. when enrichment takes >30s rr retries and causes claim thrash across timezone pools. leads go unowned for 3-7m.

vikram_eng: quick idea: introduce a claim-quarantine state for 2 minutes when an enrichment response is deferred. while quarantined, block pool-hopping and limit rr to 1 retry. then fall back to overflow routing.

elaine_mktg: that could work. also propose a lightweight SDR digest for any lead unassigned >90s so humans can rescue high-intent webinar signups.

sue_sdr: i'll take digest. keep it email/Slack with lead, timestamp, orig campaign, and one-click claim link.

integration-bot: FYI HubSpot can resend events; implement idempotency by checking event_id + external_id before creating new claim attempts.

ovar_salesops: playbook draft:
- on webhook -> if response == 202 -> set state=QUARANTINED ttl=120s
- while QUARANTINED: block pool reassignment, allow 1 claim attempt only
- after ttl: if still no owner -> route to OVERFLOW pool and send digest entry if lead is webinar type
- dedupe: ignore duplicate claim requests for same lead_id within 20s window and log incident

vikram_eng: eng tasks i can own today:
- add QUARANTINED flag + ttl 120s (PR)
- rr: enforce single-retry semantics and claim dedupe 20s (PR)
- expose metrics: quarantined_count, claim_dedupe_rate (Prom)

elain_mktg: ops/tasks:
- sue: setup digest template and pilot this afternoon
- omar: update handoff runbook + add quick-check list for oncall (logs to inspect: rr.claim_id, webhook.event_id)
- ops-oncall: add alert: if quarantined_count > 30 for 10m -> page oncall

integration-bot: webhook snippet for docs:
```
POST /hooks/hubspot
{ "event_id": "evt_...", "external_id": "lead_...", "type": "enrichment_needed" }
// if queued -> respond 202 and set state=QUARANTINED
// if processed -> respond 200
```

vikram_eng: canary deploy plan: 10% traffic 1h, monitor median time_to_assign and claim_dedupe_rate.

elain_mktg: timeline: ship minimal flags + digest today, canary for weekend traffic, review metrics Monday.

sue_sdr: acked. will triage digest and escalate manual claims as needed.

ops-oncall: noted. will watch alerts and have rollback ready if canary causes regressions.

elain_mktg: thanks team 680 44d closing once PRs merged + digest live.
